steps.fact: CRM row MER-55 names the counterparty as Meridian Energy Partners.
The billing record billed_name is Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
Commercial notes state that Meridian Energy Partners invoices are the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.
The packet does not state that MER-55 is Meridian Energy Partners LLC, does not supply a shared legal identifier for both referents, and does not license identifier uniqueness.
Partial name overlap (Meridian Energy Partners vs Meridian Energy Partners LLC) does not establish identity under the grounding contract.

support_claim: Each referent is named in separate records, but the packet provides no shared legal identifier, explicit mapping, or uniqueness license to establish that crm:MER-55 and billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC denote the same legal counterparty.
